result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The main issues are a typo in the search placeholder, a time pill that overlaps the first 'Fastest near you' card, and a few low-contrast or inconsistent elements.

issues.description: The search placeholder has a typo: 'Restarants' should be 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the string to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill sits over the plate image and its left edge is offset from the card edge. It looks misaligned compared with the other cards' pills, and it slightly overlaps the plate illustration.
issues.suggestion: Align the time pills consistently (same inset from the card's left and bottom edges) so they don't collide with the image content.

issues.description: The secondary grey text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', the '(500+)' count, and the search placeholder) is light grey on white or light grey. This gives low contrast and hurts readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons are inconsistent. On the ramen card it is a white icon on a dark, nearly invisible circle, and on the pizza card it sits in a translucent brown circle that is a different size. Both have weak definition against the busy photos.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button size and background, such as a solid semi-opaque circle, so the icon stays visible on any image.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative circles that clip awkwardly at the right and bottom edges, and its sharp cut corner at the bottom right looks like a rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes cleanly within the rounded banner, or simplify them.
